Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Exact PvP nameplate/LB cues, reliable held helpers, Smart Tab, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with exact native-nameplate cues, LB activation and damage notifications, pressure and CC awareness, a bounded Purify-first held-action scheduler, melee Smart Tab, optional Smart Action and assist macros, local MP sounds, survival/job helpers, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Default-off Smart Tab can now replace FFXIV's forward world-target cycle for reviewed melee jobs in exact Crystalline Conflict when enabled in Targets or with /smarttab. Paired native handler/helper hooks preserve FFXIV's binding and UI/input gates; OFF, reverse, and calls outside that handler stay vanilla. Pre-setter failures consume only the owned cycle without a target write. Setter rejection or readback mismatch is terminal with no retry, rerank, or alternate. The separate default-off /smartaction macro retains the harmful-action redirect. Schema 33; all 398 Core tests pass.
